description: Document-level ablations for v7 PDF graph relation modeling. All experiments consume the same clean labeled .pt manifest and never mutate source graphs.

experiments.name: A00_full_ce_ohem
experiments.purpose: Main model: full v7 features, GATv2, deep directional head, CE with OHEM hard negatives.

experiments.name: A01_no_scibert
experiments.purpose: Measure how much SciBERT semantics help after layout features and punctuation probes exist.

experiments.name: A02_semantic_only
experiments.purpose: Opposite control: keep SciBERT, remove all non-semantic node features.

experiments.name: A03_no_reading_flow
experiments.purpose: Remove scroll-y, sequence, column, band, and flow cues to quantify v7 reading-flow value.

experiments.name: A04_no_style_title
experiments.purpose: Remove PyMuPDF style stats and title probes to test heading hierarchy dependence.

experiments.name: A05_no_punctuation_probes
experiments.purpose: Remove terminal-punctuation and hyphen probes to test MERGE boundary signal.

experiments.name: A06_no_gutter_band_barriers
experiments.purpose: Remove cross-column gutter and band-flow edge features to quantify physical barrier value.

experiments.name: A07_shallow_predictor
experiments.purpose: Replace deep directional edge MLP with a shallow head to measure predictor capacity.

experiments.name: A08_no_ohem
experiments.purpose: Same full model without OHEM, showing long-tail hard-negative effect.

experiments.name: A10_random_none_dropout
experiments.purpose: Random NONE dropout comparison; expected to improve recall but often hurts precision.
